record.field: What is Interntion and how does it work?
general
Interntion is a UK EduTech platform that matches ambitious students with real, paid internships across 20+ sectors, and provides CV preparation, mentorship and job-readiness support.
Are Interntion internships paid?
general
Yes. All internships facilitated by Interntion are real, paid internships.
Who can apply for internships through Interntion?
eligibility
Any UK student or international student studying in the UK, from undergraduate to PhD level, can apply.
How long does it take to get placed?
process
Most students are placed within a few weeks of completing their profile, CV review and interview preparation.
Do you help international students get UK internships?
international
Yes, Interntion actively supports international students studying in the UK with placements and visa-friendly guidance.
What industries does Interntion place students in?
general
Students are placed across 20+ industries including Technology, Finance, Marketing, Healthcare, Engineering and more.
Is there a fee to use Interntion?
payment
Core placement services are free for students; premium mentorship and project-assistance packages may carry a fee.
Do you provide CV writing and interview preparation?
process
Yes, we provide ATS-optimised CV writing, LinkedIn profile support, cover letters and mock interviews.
What is your success rate and how is it measured?
general
Our success rate (95%+) is measured as the share of active applicants who receive and accept an internship offer, tracked live on the CRM dashboard.
How is Interntion different from Bright Network or RateMyPlacement?
general
Unlike listing-only platforms, Interntion provides end-to-end, hands-on placement support: mentorship, CV preparation and guaranteed application tracking through to offer.
